clusters.label: Strategic discipline for AI-augmented decision-making
clusters.rationale: This cluster groups the core strategic and agency-preserving concepts from the first source. They all directly relate to the overarching approach of treating decision-making as a strategic discipline and designing for human agency.

clusters.label: Multi-dimensional decision framework and Cynefin
clusters.rationale: These two candidates form the classification and diagnostic toolkit for decisions. One introduces the eight dimensions, the other zooms into the Cynefin domain model, which is one of those dimensions. They are distinct but closely related as parts of the same framework.

clusters.label: AI and Decision-making research areas overview
clusters.rationale: All candidates from the second source introduce distinct but related research areas within the AI and Decision-making field. While each is a separate subfield, they collectively form a catalog of the field's scope. They are grouped together because they all serve as an introductory mapping of the discipline, which is likely to be evaluated as a single overview concept or split into domain-specific concepts during evaluation.
